failure_modes.name: Logical_Reasoning_Error
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 correctly notes that 'the absence of his name in the film's description is not the same as explicit confirmation that he was not in it.' However, Summary 2 then claims 'Passage [1] directly contradicts the claim' by stating Malkovich appeared in Rounders. But the claim asserts Malkovich 'had not played in' Rounders—a negative statement. The presence of Rounders in Malkovich's filmography would refute, not 'contradict,' the claim. The solver conflates contradiction with refutation and makes an error in connecting the evidence (filmography listing) to the logical structure of the claim (negative assertion).
